worldcombat.skill.icehammer.summary: A free-aimed ice-packed hammer: a real short fist path strikes the first thing it meets; a hit knocks the target back and leaves it chilled (movement speed down 15%), and the natural ground reachable below the real contact point freezes into a slippery block of ice for a while. The user loses Speed by the real amount. Already-chilled targets take more. No ground means only a shatter; machines and containers are never turned to ice. The glaciate form chills longer with a larger patch, at the cost of a lighter hit and a slower cast.
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.use.0: Trade a heavy ice blow for one hard target and slow it down
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.use.1: Freeze the natural ground at the real contact point to force movement
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.use.2: Answer an already-chilled target with a heavier shatter
A real short ice-fist path along the aim strikes only the first target it meets for %1$s physical damage at %2$s blocks reach; against an already chilled target the blow deals about 15% more.
A hit knocks the target %1$s blocks away from the user (less if blocked) and lowers the user's Speed by the real amount (about %2$s stage(s); less or none at the minimum), slowing its movement.

A hit leaves the target chilled for %1$s, lowering its movement speed by 15%; the natural ground reachable below the real contact point freezes into a slippery block of ice, radius %2$s blocks, lasting %3$s, with the original blocks returning when it expires. Machines and containers are never turned to ice; with no reachable ground only a shatter remains.
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.glaciate.on: Glaciate form: chill duration x1.4, frost radius %1$s blocks and frost lasting %2$s s; costs x0.92 damage and a slower wind-up and recovery.
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.glaciate.off: Shatter form: a heavier, faster hit, but a shorter chill and a smaller frozen patch.
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.growth.0: From level %1$s the blow power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.growth.1: From level %1$s the blow power rises to %2$s and the frost radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.preference.g: On: chill duration x1.4 and a larger, longer-lasting frozen patch; costs power x0.92, wind-up +2 ticks, recovery +2 ticks, cooldown +6 ticks. Off (shatter): a heavier, faster hit, but a shorter chill and a smaller patch.
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger opens the blow from farther, but it is easier to sidestep during the wind-up.

On: targets already chilled rank higher, since this blow is heavier against them; off: being chilled makes no difference. A target standing on natural exposed ground also scores a little higher, treating the blow as ice-slip value.
